findings.before: A retained run could remain DISPLAY-authorized after a current license denied or did not establish STORE. A new pair/common request still persisted licensed canonical payloads, and fresh exposure/path/held-fund/holdings requests created new ordered membership and parent binding copies without a new STORE check. A permission or actual source-expiry boundary crossing during calculation/publication also needed final authorization before sealing/commit.
findings.correction: Shared storage guards recheck pinned and current DISPLAY plus STORE and the earliest actual source expiry under existing owner locks. Fresh exposure/path/held-fund/source memberships, including empty bindings, and pair/common payloads check before and after creation. Final run publication rechecks after calculation/encoding and before sealing. Failures roll back new copies and reservations. Existing first-page reuse, cursor continuation and explicit retained transient Top keep their DISPLAY-only read boundary.
findings.correction_status: source correction sealed; nine focused and 54 full X-ray PostgreSQL cases passed, typing and affected development gate passed; final immutable candidate acceptance pending
findings.discovered_by: Persistence source review, with public-facade analysis extending the same boundary to fresh ordered membership and parent bindings.
findings.expiry_source: Run deadlines come from six owner/input-scoped MIN joins over actual immutable source headers; constituent holdings use the minimum snapshot/mapping/fund deadline. No public preview is used as the complete license or expiry inventory.
regression_cases: Denied and unknown STORE block all fresh copies, including empty metadata collections, while retained reads remain available.
Time-activated STORE and DISPLAY denial and actual source expiry block final publication before sealing.
STORE or expiry crossing during pair calculation or payload encoding rolls back generated payloads and collection reservations.
findings.reproduction: Create a licensed immutable run, retain an existing collection, append a current license with DISPLAY allowed and STORE denied or unknown, and request a previously unmaterialized view/selection using the retained run/source. The old path could add durable projection or collection rows while display reads remained authorized.
findings.title: Recheck STORE and actual source expiry when creating new durable copies from an authorized retained run
